item.tib: rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa'i phyag rgya gar gyi nges tshig zab lam theg pa'i sgo 'byed dga' dbang gter gyi tshom bu
item.coloph: ces sku gsum rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ mtha' bsgyar las kyi yan lag phyag rgya zin tho/ zab lam theg pa'i sgo 'byed/ dga' dbang gter gyi tshom bu zhes bya ba/ gsang chen lung gi bdag nyid grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po yab yum gyis lung mngon sum du 'phos pa bzhin/ rten 'brel yang zab ma bzhag lhun grub kyi/ gsang chen bstan pa rin chen dar zhing rgyas par gyur ba'i ched/ kho bo rtsod bral sngags sems rig 'dzin gar dbang bde chen dbang po'am/ pad+ma bdud 'dul las rab rtsal lam/ tshe dbang 'gyur med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ 'dzin byed 'bras ldan gro bzhin khang chib de dbyung byed pa'i nyin du/ bden gnyis tshad ma'i yongs 'dzin sems dpa' nyer lnga'i mchog gyur pa'i bdag nyid spa ston sur+Ya kha ri bka' yi cod paN spyi bor bcing ste/ mos slob kyi nye gnas dam pa dge 'dun rin chen dang / seng ha nyi ri zung gis gus pa'i phyag dang bcas nas rkyen bskul te bgyis pa'o//
